fact: Al Ahdath Al Maghribia, relayed by le360 on 21-22 April 2025, reports that the Interior Ministry's DGCT launched an international tender (opening 29 May 2025, budget over MAD 194 million) to digitise more than 38 million registers across 1,821 civil status offices and connect all offices to a unified central information system.
title: Vaste projet de numérisation des registres de l’état civil
